checks: Old saves migrate without inventing Christmas appointments and malformed invitations are rejected
Invitation replies preserve real commitments, never farm rewards, and can be revised remotely
Unanswered invitations cost affection once on the deadline and are no longer a promise
Only memories actually owned and protected words already kept can change Nari’s decision
Nari remembers when the player pressed or peeked instead of inventing patience
Other unresolved hearts make Nari withdraw while friend and deferred answers remain distinct
Nari’s own request to wait has no player-delay penalty and resolves on New Year’s Day
An exclusive partner and Nari’s night appointment require separate, honest decisions
Every existing lover must agree to the group Christmas; Nari remains a proposal until January’s consent
Replying to Nari’s own confession does not make her repeat “나도 좋아해” back
A hidden relationship reaches Christmas’s real clash without requiring a fabricated witness
The Christmas broadcast freezes shared history at airtime and replay never includes a second confession
All invitation scenes are reachable through actual seeded itineraries and keep unmet people hidden
scope: Production holiday decisions, save restore, seeded invitation encounters and broadcast provenance; runtime and browser layout are separate checks.
